description_text:
Funny Runner, Casual Teen, and Casual Queen, three monsters who were originally meant to appear in the cancelled animation OneyPlays: The Manganomicon. They were creatures who would've emerged from the how-to-draw manga book that Chris and Ding Dong were reading. However, a fatal error occured in the scene where the armatures of some of the characters stopped functioning, and at the time I couldn't find a solution or a fix for it. Subsequently, I had to cancel it. Only the very first scene made it to completion, and it's on YouTube, and as a result these three characters unfortunately never made it to the YouTube big screen.
The three monsters (from left to right in the first image) are Casual Teen, Funny Runner, and Casual Queen, and are loosely based off of characters of the same name featured in Christopher Hart's Kids Draw Big Book of Everything Manga. All three of them are heavily stylized and extremely hideous, with a unique custom shader that gives them a cel-shaded sketchy look. All three of them are also loose parodies of B-movie horror media.
Funny Runner is essentially a parody of the Tremors film franchise, and is modeled off of a screecher. Casual Teen is a extremely loose parody of IT by Stephen King, particularly Bill Skarsgård's portrayal of the titular villain. He has a floppy weiner and a wobbly chin. Casual Queen, of course, is a parody of David Cronenberg's remake of The Fly, and has saggy grandma .
